task.description: Extract people, places and dates from one English sentence as strict JSON. This is the task the catalog's Qwen 3.5 0.8B adapter's publisher states; the spec applies to an adapter for any base model.

prompt.system: Extract named entities from the sentence. Return strict JSON only with keys people, places, dates. Each value must be an array of strings. Use [] when empty.

source.license: OntoNotes Release 5.0 (LDC2013T19) terms; the Hugging Face card declares license 'other'. Training and evaluation operators must hold the LDC terms. Item lists here carry digests only, never text.

selection.use: Checkpoint and hyperparameter selection only; never scored here.

heldOut.use: Scored once per receipt. Sentences whose normalized text appears in training or selection files are excluded.

retention.use: General capability the adapter must not lose: grade-school arithmetic word problems.
retention.prompt:
Solve the problem. Show brief working, then end with the final number on its own line.

{input}

task.definition: Micro F1 over people, places and dates. An output counts only if the whole reply (optionally inside one Markdown code fence) parses as a JSON object with exactly those three keys, each an array of strings; otherwise every gold entity is a miss. Entities match per key by case-folded NFKC text with whitespace removed, as multisets.

independence.note: The evaluator runs the frozen prompts through Doppler for the base model and the exact adapter identity, then scores with scripts/adapter-evaluation.js. Training never reads held-out or retention files.
